# SBOM — Told — the parables, firsthand

**Last updated:** 2026-10-29  
**Runtime:** Node.js (Express) + React frontend  
**Lockfile of record:** `backend/package-lock.json`, `frontend/package-lock.json` — transitive dependencies live there, not here  
**Deployed at:** https://told.thegreatpursuit.faith  
**Machine-readable SBOM:** [`sbom.cdx.json`](sbom.cdx.json) — CycloneDX 1.7, **152 components including transitive dependencies**, generated by syft from the repository working copy

An interactive parables project: twenty-four of the stories Jesus told, stepped into one choice at a time — you're not watching from a pew, you're inside the story.

> **Two files, two jobs.** `sbom.cdx.json` is the SBOM proper — CycloneDX, machine-readable, every transitive dependency with a PURL, and what a vulnerability scanner reads (`grype sbom:sbom.cdx.json`). This file is the human companion: the *direct* dependencies and why each is here, what data leaves the machine, how it is deployed, and what the risks are — the judgment a scanner cannot supply. When the two disagree about package facts, the JSON wins.

## External services & APIs

| Service | Used for | Credential (env var name) | What leaves the machine |
|---|---|---|---|
| Anthropic API (`api.anthropic.com`) | Claude inference: scene generation | `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` (Keychain: `TOLD_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`) | prompt text — the story's system prompt plus the player's stats, choices and journal lines. No names or emails. |

> Values are never recorded here — only the variable names. Secrets live in the macOS Keychain locally and in the service `.env` on the droplet.

## AI models

| Model | Provider routing | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `claude-haiku-5-5` | Anthropic API, direct (`@anthropic-ai/sdk`) | `effort: low`, `max_tokens` 16000; no sampling parameters; no server-side fallback exists for Haiku 5.5. Not a PRC-risk family, so the OpenRouter provider pin does not apply, and Told no longer calls OpenRouter at all. |

## License summary

All direct dependencies are permissive — MIT / Apache-2.0 / BSD / ISC / Unlicense. No copyleft (GPL / AGPL / LGPL) in the direct dependency set.

*Scope: this summary covers direct dependencies. `sbom.cdx.json` carries the license field for every transitive component too — check there before distributing.*

## Known risks & notes

- The `esbuild` binary vendored in `node_modules` reports critical Go stdlib advisories (GO-2024-2887, GO-2025-3563, GO-2026-4337). It is a **build-time** tool — the frontend ships as pre-built static files and esbuild never runs in production — so this is low priority, but it will keep appearing in every scan until the toolchain is updated.
